preconditions.description: The length of the string n and the number of operations m are within the specified range.
The length of the string s matches the given length n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= len(s) for l, r, c in operations)
preconditions.description: For each operation, the positions l and r are within the bounds of the current string length.

postconditions.expression: result == ''.join(c for i, c in enumerate(s) if all(l > i or i > r or s[i] != c for l, r, c in operations))
postconditions.description: The resulting string is obtained by removing all occurrences of character c in the range [l, r] for each operation.
